name: Paper Tape
description: Wide strips of punched paper tape in pastel colors on a dark ground, a line of small feed holes along each and big data holes punched at random above and below it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-mask: @match(y % 2 == 0, @var(--feed), none); mask: @match(y % 2 == 0, @var(--feed), none); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: @match(y % 2 == 1, 14%, -0.6%); bottom: @match(y % 2 == 1, -0.6%, 14%); background: @match(floor((y - 1) / 2) % 4 == 0, @p(var(--color1)), floor((y - 1) / 2) % 4 == 1, @p(var(--color2)), floor((y - 1) / 2) % 4 == 2, @p(var(--color3)), @p(var(--color4))); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 72%, #000 72%) 0 0 / 25% 33.333%, linear-gradient(180deg, @match(y % 2 == 0, #000, @p(#000, #000, transparent)) 0.00% 33.33%, @p(#000, #000, transparent) 33.33% 66.67%, @p(#000, #000, transparent) 66.67% 100.00%) 0% 0 / 25% 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(180deg, @match(y % 2 == 0, #000, @p(#000, #000, transparent)) 0.00% 33.33%, @p(#000, #000, transparent) 33.33% 66.67%, @p(#000, #000, transparent) 66.67% 100.00%) 33.33% 0 / 25% 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(180deg, @match(y % 2 == 0, #000, @p(#000, #000, transparent)) 0.00% 33.33%, @p(#000, #000, transparent) 33.33% 66.67%, @p(#000, #000, transparent) 66.67% 100.00%) 66.67% 0 / 25% 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(180deg, @match(y % 2 == 0, #000, @p(#000, #000, transparent)) 0.00% 33.33%, @p(#000, #000, transparent) 33.33% 66.67%, @p(#000, #000, transparent) 66.67% 100.00%) 100% 0 / 25% 100% no-repeat; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --feed: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 13.8%, transparent 4.2%, #000 4.2%) 0 0 / 25% 100%; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
